item.tib: snyan rgyud a gsal gsal bar byed pa'i mngon rtogs
item.coloph: zhes pa'i tshul 'di ni gshen gyis drang srong shes rab rgyal mtshan la / dad ldan slob ma'i 'ga'i bskul na ngor / dben gnas sman ri'i khrod du sbyar ba dge'o
item.note: this is sadhana text centered on the deity kun-bzang rgyal-ba 'dus-pa. it includes a lineage prayer in 2 fols. (equivalent to pp. 67-68) inserted between fols. 12 and 13. the lineage prayer has the following colophon: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyi sdebs kyang bzong [? --] ma byung pa'i mchod grogs rnams kyi gzigs par mdzod.
